definitions.explanation: A flat, rectangular hard- or soft-sided case used to carry documents, a laptop, and other office items. Typically associated with business attire and white-collar work.

notes:
From English "briefcase." Generally pictured as a stiff, flap-style case rather than a soft bag. In modern business settings the more flexible ⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧ has largely replaced it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ブリーフケース: leather briefcase
- ブリーフケース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to carry a briefcase
- ブリーフケース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a briefcase

- {鞄|かばん}: bag — general term, covers any kind of bag including briefcases
